categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Tongli Transmission Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of gear reducers and industrial gearboxes. Its product portfolio includes general-purpose reducers and industrial gearboxes, serving diverse industries such as metallurgy, chemical, environmental protection, energy, pharmaceuticals, lifting, logistics, construction materials, mining, textiles, aerospace, marine equipment, and engineering machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies in gear reducer transmission structure design, modular component design, lean production, and customized design. It employs advanced manufacturing equipment including CNC gear grinders, flexible processing lines, and precision testing instruments. Key production processes include precision machining, heat treatment, and surface strengthening techniques, with a focus on automation and digital manufacturing to enhance product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tongli Tech serves a broad customer base across multiple sectors such as heavy industry, new energy, pharmaceuticals, and packaging. Notable clients include major domestic enterprises like China First Heavy Industries, China Second Heavy Industries, China Metallurgical Group, COFCO Group, and CATL, as well as international customers in Southeast Asia and South America. The company targets both end-users and industrial equipment manufacturers requiring high-performance transmission solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 96% of revenue. It also exports products to regions including Southeast Asia and South America. Its manufacturing and R&D facilities are located in Zhejiang Province, with subsidiaries in Hangzhou to support high-end transmission equipment manufacturing and digitalized production.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Tongli Transmission Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial transmission supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of gear reducers and gearboxes. It procures raw materials such as steel, castings, forgings, and bearings from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and services downstream to equipment manufacturers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high R&D investment, focusing on intelligent, high-precision, and modular gear reducers. Key R&D projects include vertical parallel shaft reducers for special conditions, spiral bevel gear reducers with enhanced cooling and lubrication, planetary reducers with integrated sensors and safety features, and solutions tailored for emerging sectors like lithium battery manufacturing and new energy. It also pursues digital transformation of production and collaborates with academic institutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of gear reducers, industrial gearboxes, and related accessories, with direct sales constituting the majority and distributor sales as a supplementary channel. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control, either at customer receipt for domestic sales or upon shipment for exports. It also earns income from after-sales services and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tongli Tech is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the gear reducer industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a provincial 'Invisible Champion.' It competes with both domestic and international players, including established German, Italian, and Japanese manufacturers, by focusing on product quality, customization, and technological innovation to enhance market share and drive import substitution in precision reducers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 428 million, representing an 8.54% decline from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 52 million, down 35.67%. Total assets reached RMB 1.39 billion, with a stable equity base. Despite short-term revenue and profit declines due to market and competitive pressures, the company maintains a solid financial foundation and continues investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tongli Tech differentiates itself through a comprehensive product series with high performance, reliability, and mature customization capabilities tailored to diverse industrial applications. Its products feature advanced design, high precision, modularity, and intelligent features such as real-time condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. The company’s strong brand reputation, extensive industry experience, and commitment to quality and innovation provide customers with dependable, cost-effective transmission solutions that support high-end equipment manufacturing and industrial upgrading.
